svg.title: Which of the three ways to use. If you run your own model, or the output is not JSON at all, use Way 3, structured generation: a broken format cannot be written, and it handles labels, phone numbers, CSV rows and game boards. Otherwise, if you need custom checks or want to switch between companies, use Way 2, check and retry, which costs a full request for every retry. Otherwise use Way 1, where the AI company enforces a simple form.
